task_language: Pick the akita black bowl between the plate and the ramekin and place it on the plate

localization.method: agentview_high semantic identity, multi-pixel back_project medians, wrist close-view confirmation
localization.target_bowl_relation: lower/front patterned black bowl visually between the red-rim plate and silver ramekin; rejected the upper/right duplicate bowl

pick_result.bowl_pi0_pick_step2: reported success but firming the gripper over-tightened and the bowl did not transport to the plate
pick_result.bowl_pi0_pick_step10: successful visual hold of target bowl with gripper opening about 0.021 before scripted carry
pick_result.raised_bowl_pi0_pick_step17: regrasped staged near-plate bowl and enabled final low contact seating

strategy_notes: From step 0, classified the lower/front patterned black bowl as the one between the red-rim plate and silver ramekin using agentview RGB and back_project medians. Moved above it at [-0.075,0.20,1.06], used pi0_pick 'pick up the black patterned bowl', then discovered after release/retreat that the first grasp did not seat the bowl. Recovered in the same episode by returning to the target, using pi0_pick 'pick up the black bowl between the plate and the ramekin', carrying toward the plate with gripper held closed, and observing a large held-bowl offset. After a low release still left the bowl beside the plate, moved near the staged bowl and used pi0_pick 'pick up the raised black bowl'. The final successful manipulation was a slow low closed-gripper move_to to [0.05,0.02,0.995] with step_clip 0.004, which visibly put the bowl footprint over the plate, followed by release max_steps 35; termination fired after 3 release steps.
